jobs.title: Consumer AI Lifecycle Product and Marketing Lead (backed by Y Combinator, $5M+ ARR, $23M+ raised)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🧠 About Legion Health

At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision? A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Job Type: Full-Time

  • Role Type: Lifecycle Marketing / CRM / AI-Native Patient Engagement / Retention / Growth

  • Ideal Experience Level: 6+ years, including 3+ years owning lifecycle, CRM, retention, or owned-channel growth

  • Location: In-Person in San Francisco, CA

  • US Visa Sponsorship: Yes

🚀 The Opportunity

Legion is hiring an Consumer AI Lifecycle Product and Marketing Lead to build the AI-native patient communication engine that helps people start care, stay in care, come back when they lapse, and feel personally supported across months and years of treatment.

This is not a typical lifecycle marketing job. We are not looking for someone to manage a static email calendar, build a few drip campaigns, and optimize subject lines. Legion has rich patient data, production AI, clinical workflows, scheduling events, insurance data, intake behavior, appointment history, medication renewal patterns, and care operations all inside one vertically integrated system. That means we can build something far more powerful: a personalized, proactive communication engine that knows where each patient is in their journey and automatically helps move them to the next right step.

You will build the system that makes Legion feel impossibly responsive. A patient who stalls in intake should get the right nudge. A patient who books but does not complete prep should get the right reminder. A patient at risk of missing follow-up should be guided before they lapse. A patient due for renewal should understand what to do next. A patient who churned should receive a thoughtful, relevant path back. Over time, the engine should become more intelligent, more personalized, and more autonomous.

The right person combines the lifecycle rigor of DoorDash, Instacart, Airbnb, or Sephora; the patient-journey discipline of Hims, Thirty Madison, Headway, or Talkiatry; the retention instincts of Noom, Peloton, WHOOP, or Duolingo; and the AI-native curiosity required to build communication systems that can generate, personalize, test, and improve patient journeys at scale.

This is a founding systems-builder role. You should be comfortable designing lifecycle strategy, mapping patient states, writing copy, building CRM logic, creating segments, using AI tools, QAing flows, debugging event data, launching experiments, and partnering with product, engineering, data, ops, and clinical teams to create an engine that increasingly works on its own.

✅ Responsibilities and Deliverables

  • Build Legion’s AI-native lifecycle engine across activation, booking, visit completion, follow-up adherence, medication renewal support, retention, reactivation, and winback.

  • Design the patient communication system across email, SMS, push, in-app, transactional reminders, AI-assisted outreach, and future owned channels.

  • Map the full patient journey into clear lifecycle states, triggers, audiences, suppressions, escalation rules, personalization rules, and next-best-action logic.

  • Use Legion’s patient data to create highly personalized journeys based on intake status, appointment behavior, insurance status, treatment stage, follow-up cadence, renewal needs, engagement, risk of lapse, and communication preferences.

  • Partner with product, engineering, and data to instrument the events, properties, data models, and workflows needed for intelligent lifecycle automation.

  • Build AI-assisted communication workflows that can draft, personalize, route, test, and optimize messages while staying within approved clinical, compliance, and brand guardrails.

  • Create proactive flows for abandoned intake, incomplete booking, pre-visit preparation, appointment reminders, no-show prevention, post-visit follow-up, refill and renewal nudges, reactivation, churn recovery, and long-term engagement.

  • Build segmentation and personalization systems that can support thousands of patient-specific journeys instead of one-size-fits-all campaigns.

  • Partner with clinical operations to ensure every message reflects real care workflows, scheduling capacity, prescribing boundaries, refill policies, escalation paths, and patient support processes.

  • Own lifecycle experimentation across A/B tests, holdouts, incrementality tests, send-time tests, cadence tests, channel-mix tests, AI-personalization tests, and journey-level optimization.

  • Improve core funnel and retention metrics, including intake completion, booking conversion, visit completion, no-show rate, follow-up adherence, reactivation rate, churn, LTV, and patient satisfaction.

  • Build the QA, approval, deliverability, consent, and compliance processes required for high-volume, AI-assisted healthcare communication.

  • Ensure HIPAA, TCPA, CAN-SPAM, consent management, PHI handling, opt-outs, quiet hours, clinical accuracy, and patient trust are treated as product requirements.

  • Create lifecycle dashboards and weekly reporting that show where patients are getting stuck, which journeys are working, and where AI or automation can remove manual work.

  • Evaluate and operate tools such as Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, HubSpot, Klaviyo, Twilio, SendGrid, PostHog, Hightouch, Segment, RudderStack, Census, OpenAI, Claude, internal AI agents, or similar.

  • Build repeatable lifecycle playbooks that can scale across states, payers, patient segments, care pathways, and future service lines.

🏆 You’ll Be Successful If You…

  • Build a lifecycle engine that feels less like marketing automation and more like an intelligent patient guidance system.

  • Turn Legion’s data into personalized, proactive communication that helps patients take the right next action.

  • Meaningfully improve intake completion, booking conversion, kept visits, follow-up adherence, renewal completion, reactivation, and retention.

  • Reduce manual ops work by automating the right nudges, reminders, escalations, and follow-ups before patients fall through the cracks.

  • Make patients feel guided, cared for, and understood, not blasted by generic campaigns.

  • Build event-triggered journeys that move real patient behavior instead of static campaign calendars that sit inside a CRM tool.

  • Create AI-assisted workflows that are useful, accurate, safe, and compliant.

  • Build a testing culture where lifecycle performance improves every week.

  • Maintain extremely high QA standards so messages are accurate, well-timed, correctly personalized, and safe.

  • Help Legion understand which patients are stuck, likely to lapse, ready to return, due for follow-up, or likely to need additional support before the problem becomes manual.

🧰 Ideal Background and Skills

  • 6+ years in lifecycle marketing, CRM, retention, engagement, growth marketing, patient engagement, consumer communications, or owned-channel marketing.

  • 3+ years directly owning lifecycle programs across email, SMS, push, in-app, transactional messaging, or direct mail.

  • Strong preference for experience in consumer healthcare, marketplaces, subscriptions, mobile apps, fintech, consumer services, e-commerce, or other high-volume consumer businesses.

  • Experience building event-triggered journeys, segmentation systems, personalization logic, suppression rules, send calendars, experimentation roadmaps, and lifecycle reporting.

  • Hands-on fluency with CRM / marketing automation platforms such as Braze, Iterable, Customer.io, Klaviyo, HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar.

  • Strong AI-native operating ability. You should be excited to use LLMs, agents, data, and automation to generate better patient journeys, not just make existing workflows slightly faster.

  • Strong analytical judgment: funnel analysis, cohort analysis, retention curves, A/B tests, holdouts, incrementality, attribution, LTV, churn, and reactivation.

  • Comfort working with data and technical teams. You do not need to be an engineer, but you should understand events, properties, audiences, data quality, QA, and basic SQL or SQL-adjacent analysis.

  • Excellent patient-facing writing judgment. You can make a message clear, warm, action-oriented, personalized, and clinically careful without sounding robotic or promotional.

  • Strong product sense. You understand that lifecycle is not just marketing; it is part of the patient experience, product experience, and operations system.

  • Strong operational rigor around QA, deliverability, consent, localization, link checking, dynamic content, approvals, and launch readiness.

  • Healthcare judgment. You understand that messages about psychiatric care, medication, insurance, no-shows, refills, and follow-up must be handled with real care.

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with product, engineering, data, clinical operations, customer support, compliance, legal, design, and growth.

  • Low ego, high ownership, and startup intensity. You can define the strategy on Monday, build the segment Tuesday, write the copy Wednesday, QA the flow Thursday, and read the results Friday.

  • Bonus: experience with HIPAA, TCPA, PHI handling, patient engagement, appointment reminders, medication adherence, healthcare CRM, telehealth, LLMs, AI agents, or regulated consumer products.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $140,000 – $260,000, based on experience

  • Early-Stage Equity: Meaningful ownership in a category-defining company.

  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Additional Perks: In-person retreats, meal stipends, lifecycle/CRM tooling budget, learning stipend, AI tooling budget

  • Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

  • Work Hours: Flexible, with responsiveness around high-impact launches or patient communication issues

  • Work Setup: In-Person in San Francisco, CA

  • Impact: Build the AI-native communication system that helps patients access and stay in high-quality psychiatric care.

  • Autonomy and Learning: Own lifecycle strategy, CRM infrastructure, patient journeys, AI-assisted personalization, experimentation, reporting, and retention systems end-to-end.

  • Growth Opportunities: As Legion scales, this role can grow into Head of Lifecycle, Head of CRM, Head of Patient Engagement, or a broader growth leadership role.

📝 How to Apply and Hiring Process

  • Apply here: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/legionhealth/3a007cb1-faad-4854-a847-e4b77eaf3a42

  • Overview of our hiring process:

    1. Resume + Application Screen

    2. Founder Interview

    3. Lifecycle + AI Systems Deep Dive

    4. Professional Reference Checks

  • Estimated time-to-hire: 2 weeks

  • Start date: ASAP

  • Hiring manager: Arthur MacWaters

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Staff Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) — Remote | Telehealth | Full-Time or Part-Time | Multiple States
jobs.descriptionHtml:
[We show compassion to heal minds.]

 

🧠 About Legion Health

Legion Health is a technology-forward psychiatry company delivering world-class outpatient mental health care while expanding access for patients through insurance.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional PMHNPs operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced psychiatrists through consults and peer case reviews.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

 

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for PMHNPs who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered PMHNPs to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

 

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Collaborating Physician Coverage: Where applicable, we provide your collaborating psychiatrist and fully cover the costs.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented PMHNPs and psychiatrists in the world. Our current PMHNPs have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions, including Vanderbilt, UT Austin, Johns Hopkins, Columbia, NYU, and UTHealth Houston.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

 

✅ Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with psychiatrists and clinical peers through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

 

🧰 Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted state-issued authority to practice as a PMHNP in at least one U.S. state or jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

 

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

  • Compensation: $150K–$300K per year, depending on completed patient-care hours.

 

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our Clinical Advisory Board include:

  • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

 

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based PMHNP who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

 

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

 - Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

 - Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

 - Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

 - Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented PMHNPs and psychiatrists in the world. Our current PMHNPs have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions, including Vanderbilt, UT Austin, Johns Hopkins, Columbia, NYU, and UTHealth Houston.

 - Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

 - Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

 - Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

 - Collaborate with psychiatrists and clinical peers through consultations and case reviews.

 - Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

 


🧰 QUALIFICATIONS

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Care Loop (backed by Y Combinator, $5M+ ARR, $23M+ raised)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🧠 About Legion Health

At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision? A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.

 

🚀 The role

Hey, I'm Daniel Wilson, co-founder and CTO at Legion. I studied applied math and CS at Princeton, led the Office Scripts and Power Automate integration at Microsoft, and did deep learning and RL research before that. GitHub: github.com/danielgwilson

I'm hiring a product engineer to ship the care loop: the path a real psychiatric patient travels through our platform. Booking a visit. The provider seeing their history at a glance. The prescription going out. The follow-up landing on the calendar. Right now our providers run thousands of visits a month on legacy tools while we move them onto the platform we built, and the engineer in this seat is the one who makes that platform good enough that nobody misses the old one.

This is not a ticket-taking job and it is not an infra job. It's the seat for someone whose instinct, handed "the provider can't scan the patient's meds fast enough during a live visit," is to go sit in on a visit, fix the screen, ship it that week, and then fix the three things they noticed while they were in there. The best engineer we've had in this lane got hired in 8 days and owned an entire e-prescribing integration within a month. That's the pattern this seat rewards.

✅ What you'll own

  • The live clinic test. We're driving to a full clinic day on our platform with zero fallback to legacy tools. The current gap list is specific: prior-visit context at a glance, medication lists a clinician can scan in seconds, unambiguous pharmacy selection, prescription status you can trust, patient accounts and visit links that just work. You ship these.

  • The patient surface. Booking, intake, portal, messaging, reminders: the experience that decides whether a psychiatric patient in Texas feels taken care of or lost.

  • The provider surface. The screens a nurse practitioner uses with a live patient in the room. Scannability and correctness here are clinical safety, not polish.

  • The loop end to end. Visit to note to prescription to follow-up, as one coherent flow rather than four features. You'll work against our event-sourced clinical spine (orders, tasks, receipts) with a principal engineer owning the substrate under you.

  • Agent-assisted everything. We ship with AI agents as a matter of course, and your work goes to production weekly at minimum, usually faster.

🏆 What "a fit" looks like, concretely

  • You've shipped real product 0-to-1 or 1-to-N and owned it after launch: not tickets, features with your name on them and users who noticed.

  • You move across the stack without ceremony: Next.js and TypeScript on the front, Postgres and event-driven services behind it.

  • You use AI coding agents daily and can show us your setup. We care what you let them do and how you check them.

  • You have product taste under constraint: you can make a screen a stressed clinician reads in three seconds, and you know that's a different problem than making it pretty.

  • Handed an ambiguous feature, you go look at the real workflow (sit in the visit, read the transcript, call the ops person) before you write code.

  • Experience level: doesn't matter if you're cracked. Our best hire in this lane was early-career; the bar is slope and ownership, not years.

This role is not for you if you need a spec before you can start, you think of frontend as someone else's job (or backend as someone else's job), or shipping to real patients weekly sounds stressful rather than like the whole point.

💻 Tech Stack

TypeScript and Node.js, Next.js 15 on Vercel, Postgres, event-sourced clinical records, production LLM agents (Anthropic, OpenAI) with tool-calling and evals, e-prescribing and EHR integrations, PHI-grade security and audit trails.

📍 Logistics

  • Job type: Full-time

  • Role type: Engineering

  • US Visa Sponsorship: Yes

  • Salary: $160,000 to $260,000 depending on experience, plus meaningful early-stage equity in a category defining company.

  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Additional Perks: In-person retreats, meal stipends, etc.

  • Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

  • Work hours: flexible but demanding—because we are (literally) saving lives.

  • Work Setup: In-person @ San Francisco HQ.

  • Impact: Work on something that truly matters to millions of patients and families.

  • Autonomy and Learning: Ownership over your projects with the freedom to set priorities, shape processes, and drive outcomes end-to-end.

  • Growth Opportunities: As we scale, we envision our top performers stepping into expanded roles and joining our executive leadership team.

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

  • Location: In-Person in San Francisco, CA

  • US Visa Sponsorship: Yes

Legion is hiring a GTM Engineer to build the AI-native commercial and referral infrastructure behind our provider-partnership motion. Your systems will help us identify the right provider organizations, reach the right stakeholders, turn interest into referrals, and move referred patients into care quickly.

This is not a traditional RevOps or CRM administration job. You will own the technical architecture from market mapping and outbound through referral intake, attribution, eligibility, onboarding, and partner reporting. You will configure best-in-class tools when they are sufficient and write code or build integrations, agents, and internal products when they are not.

You will build both sides of our sales motion. From the bottom up, Legion needs a complete view of every clinic, location, physician, referral coordinator, and office leader in a market. From the top down, we need to map enterprise medical groups, centralized referral teams, executives, clinical leaders, and every stakeholder who can shape a partnership. The system should tell each representative who matters, why they matter, what happened last, and what to do next.

You will also engineer the path from referral to care. Referrals may arrive through fax, forms, APIs, tracked links, QR codes, phone calls, or patients who begin online after a provider recommendation. Regardless of channel, Legion must identify the source, resolve the provider and organization, preserve attribution, process the referral, initiate eligibility and onboarding, and synchronize the right data across our CRM, product, analytics, and patient-engagement systems.

The right person is a hands-on systems builder with strong product judgment. You should be comfortable choosing a CRM, modeling complex account hierarchies, writing SQL and lightweight production code, integrating APIs, deploying AI workflows, debugging failures, and partnering with sales, product, engineering, data, operations, clinical, compliance, and security teams. Over time, you will help turn provider partnerships into a secure product that makes Legion the easiest specialty care partner in the country: simple to refer patients to, easy to collaborate with, and consistently responsive.

✅ Responsibilities and Deliverables

  • Select and architect Legion’s provider-partnership CRM—whether HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, or another AI-native platform—as the source of truth for organizations, locations, stakeholders, opportunities, referrals, ownership, and next actions.

  • Design a durable account hierarchy that connects individual clinicians, clinic locations, care teams, medical groups, parent organizations, enterprise partnerships, and internal owners without losing history or context.

  • Build a provider prospecting data layer using NPI and claims data, Definitive Healthcare or similar datasets, public sources, enrichment providers, and Legion’s internal data.

  • Create account-scoring and territory systems that prioritize targets using geography, specialty, patient volume, payer mix, referral potential, network relationships, and engagement signals.

  • Build coordinated outbound workflows across email, phone, LinkedIn, direct mail, events, lunch-and-learns, and field sales using tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, sequencing platforms, AI agents, and custom integrations.

  • Map clinic-level champions and referral coordinators alongside enterprise executives, clinical leaders, operations leaders, and centralized referral teams so Legion can sell from the bottom up and the top down.

  • Equip sales representatives with accurate contact data, office addresses, account briefs, relationship history, meeting preparation, follow-up automation, and clear next-best actions.

  • Deploy AI-assisted workflows for account research, stakeholder discovery, enrichment, outreach drafting, call intelligence, CRM updates, and follow-up with appropriate evaluations and human review.

  • Build an omnichannel referral-ingestion layer that turns fax, forms, APIs, tracked links, QR codes, phone calls, provider handoffs, and patients who begin online after a provider recommendation into structured, traceable records.

  • Automate referral processing, including document extraction, provider and organization matching, deduplication, completeness checks, routing, exception handling, and audit trails.

  • Connect referral intake to insurance eligibility and AI-native front-desk workflows for patient outreach, onboarding, and scheduling so referred patients reach the right next step without avoidable delays.

  • Own end-to-end attribution across the referring clinician, clinic, parent organization, partnership, sales representative, campaign, channel, UTM, QR code, landing page, fax source, and downstream patient journey.

  • Integrate the provider CRM, Legion’s database, the patient-facing CRM, PostHog, Braze or another lifecycle platform, analytics systems, and custom applications into one coherent data flow.

  • Partner with product and engineering to build secure provider-facing dashboards and workflows for referral volume, referral status, time-to-contact, scheduling progress, coverage and copay information, and other authorized care-coordination information.

  • Build compliant workflows that return medical records, care summaries, and status updates to referring care teams through approved fax, secure email, portal, interoperability, or other authorized channels at the right cadence.

  • Create dashboards and operating reviews for market coverage, stakeholder penetration, outreach performance, pipeline, referral volume, conversion, speed to care, repeat referrals, partner expansion, and revenue impact.

  • Own production reliability across monitoring, logging, retries, rate-limit handling, identity resolution, testing, versioning, access control, documentation, and recovery when systems fail.

  • Treat HIPAA, PHI handling, minimum-necessary access, role-based permissions, audit trails, consent, and provider trust as product requirements in every automated workflow.

  • Make disciplined build-versus-buy decisions, ship useful first versions quickly, and drive adoption through clear playbooks, training, and change management.

🏆 You’ll Be Successful If You…

  • Give Legion a provider CRM and data model that the team trusts as the source of truth.

  • Create a complete, prioritized map of each market so representatives spend time with the right organizations and people.

  • Build a repeatable outbound engine that produces qualified provider conversations and pipeline through coordinated digital, field, bottom-up, and top-down plays.

  • Ensure every referral is captured, processed, routed, and attributed correctly regardless of how it arrives.

  • Reduce the time from referral to eligibility, patient contact, onboarding, scheduling, and completed care.

  • Give referring care teams a secure, useful experience that increases trust and repeat referrals.

  • Remove repetitive research, data entry, document processing, routing, follow-up, and reporting work without sacrificing accuracy or judgment.

  • Build reliable systems that sales and operations adopt, improve continuously, and measurably increase referral volume, conversion, speed to care, partner retention, and revenue.

🧰 Ideal Background and Skills

  • 5+ years in GTM engineering, revenue operations, sales operations, growth engineering, business systems, data engineering, internal tools, or another systems-building role close to revenue.

  • 3+ years directly owning CRM architecture, GTM automation, data pipelines, outbound infrastructure, attribution, or technically complex revenue programs.

  • Strong technical foundation: advanced SQL plus the ability to write and review production-quality Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript for integrations, automations, and internal tools.

  • Deep CRM fluency in HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, or similar, including objects, associations, account hierarchies, lifecycle stages, permissions, routing, reporting, deduplication, and data governance.

  • Hands-on experience with APIs, webhooks, ETL or reverse ETL, event instrumentation, identity resolution, error handling, observability, and modern data warehouses.

  • Practical fluency with modern GTM tools such as Clay, Apollo, Definitive Healthcare, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, Salesloft, n8n, Make, Zapier, Workato, or equivalent platforms.

  • Production experience with LLM-powered research, extraction, classification, routing, or agentic automation, including structured outputs, evaluations, monitoring, confidence thresholds, and human-in-the-loop review.

  • Strong analytical judgment across funnels, attribution, pipeline, conversion, velocity, cohort analysis, experimentation, and revenue impact.

  • Strong product sense and build-versus-buy judgment. You can turn a messy frontline problem into a coherent system that people trust and use.

  • Strong preference for experience in healthcare, provider partnerships, referrals, physician networks, field sales, multi-location organizations, or another complex relationship-driven business.

  • Healthcare and security judgment: disciplined access controls, auditability, minimum-necessary access and data use, consent, and close partnership with compliance and clinical leaders.

  • Bonus: experience with eFax, referral management, EHR integrations, HL7, FHIR, eligibility, claims, provider directories, or NPI data.

  • Excellent cross-functional communication. You can translate the needs of a sales representative, referral coordinator, operator, clinician, engineer, analyst, and executive into a system that works.

  • Low ego, high ownership, and startup intensity. You can diagnose the bottleneck, design the solution, ship a useful version, measure the result, and improve it quickly.

  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Additional Perks: In-person retreats, meal stipends, GTM and revenue-systems tooling budget, learning stipend, AI tooling budget

  • Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

  • Work Hours: Flexible, with responsiveness around high-impact launches or system issues

  • Work Setup: In-Person in San Francisco, CA

  • Impact: Build the technical system that turns partnerships into faster access to high-quality medical care for all.

  • Autonomy and Learning: Own CRM architecture, provider data, outbound infrastructure, referral workflows, attribution, AI automation, reporting, and partner-facing systems end-to-end.

  • Growth Opportunities: As Legion scales, this role can grow into Head of GTM Engineering, Head of Revenue Operations, or a broader product and growth leadership role.

  • Apply here: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/legionhealth/3a007cb1-faad-4854-a847-e4b77eaf3a42

jobs.descriptionHtml:
[We show compassion to heal minds.]

 

🧠 About Legion Health

Legion Health is a technology-forward psychiatry company delivering world-class outpatient mental health care while expanding access for patients through insurance.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional PMHNPs operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced psychiatrists through consults and peer case reviews.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

 

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for PMHNPs who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered PMHNPs to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

 

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Collaborating Physician Coverage: Where applicable, we provide your collaborating psychiatrist and fully cover the costs.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented PMHNPs and psychiatrists in the world. Our current PMHNPs have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions, including Vanderbilt, UT Austin, Johns Hopkins, Columbia, NYU, and UTHealth Houston.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

 

✅ Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with psychiatrists and clinical peers through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

 

🧰 Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted state-issued authority to practice as a PMHNP in at least one U.S. state or jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

 

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

  • Compensation: $150K–$300K per year, depending on completed patient-care hours.

 

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our Clinical Advisory Board include:

  • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

 

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based PMHNP who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

 

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

 

🧰 Qualifications

  • An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

 

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

  • Expected annual compensation: $300K–$500K, depending on completed patient-care hours.

 

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders.   • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

 

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

 

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional psychiatrists operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced peers.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

 


🚀 ABOUT THE ROLE

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for psychiatrists who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

 


💙 BENEFITS

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

 - Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

 - Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

 - Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

 - Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

 - Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

 - Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

 - Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

 - Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

 - Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

 - Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

 - Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

 - Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

 - Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

 - Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

 - Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

 - Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

 - Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

 


✅ RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

 - Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

 - Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

 - Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

 - Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

 - Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

 - Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

 


🧰 QUALIFICATIONS

 - An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

 - Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

 - Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

 - Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

 


📍 ROLE LOGISTICS

 - Location: Fully remote within the United States.

 - Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

 - Expected annual compensation: $300K–$500K, depending on completed patient-care hours.

 


🤝 CLINICAL ADVISORY BOARD

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our clinical advisory board include:

 - Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

 - Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

 - Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

 - Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

 - John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

 - Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

 


✨ BRING YOUR BEST CLINICAL WORK TO LEGION

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

 


🤝 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatrists (MD or DO) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional psychiatrists operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced peers.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

 

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for psychiatrists who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

 

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

 

✅ Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

 

🧰 Qualifications

  • An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

 

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

  • Expected annual compensation: $300K–$500K, depending on completed patient-care hours.

 

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our clinical advisory board include:

  • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

 

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

 

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

 - Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

 - Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

 - Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

 - Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

 - Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

 - Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

 - Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

 - Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

 - Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

 - Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

 - Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

 - Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

 - Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

 - Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

 - Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

 - Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

 - Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

 - Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

 - Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

 - Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

 - Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

 - Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

 


🧰 QUALIFICATIONS

 - An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

 - Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

 - Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

 - Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

 


📍 ROLE LOGISTICS

 - Location: Fully remote within the United States.

 - Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

 - Expected annual compensation: $300K–$500K, depending on completed patient-care hours.

 - Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

 - Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

 - John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

 - Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

 


🚀 ABOUT THE ROLE

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for psychiatrists who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

 


💙 BENEFITS

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

 - Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

 - Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

 - Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

 - Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

 - Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

 - Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

 - Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

 - Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

 - Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

 - Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

 - Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

 - Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

 - Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

 - Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

 - Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

 - Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

 - Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

 


✅ RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

 - Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

 - Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

 - Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

 - Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

 - Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

 - Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

 


🧰 QUALIFICATIONS

 - An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

 - Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

 - Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

 - Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

 


📍 ROLE LOGISTICS

 - Location: Fully remote within the United States.

 - Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

 - Expected annual compensation: $300K–$500K, depending on completed patient-care hours.

 


🤝 CLINICAL ADVISORY BOARD

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our clinical advisory board include:

 - Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

 - Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

 - Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

 - Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

 - John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

 - Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

 


✨ BRING YOUR BEST CLINICAL WORK TO LEGION

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

 


🤝 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.
