Legion is a modern consumer AI software company that happens to deliver medical care. That means the product bar is closer to Anthropic, OpenAI, Character.AI http://Character.AI, Replit, Oura, WHOOP, Duolingo, Chime, Monarch, and the best consumer health companies than to traditional healthcare software. We need someone who can bring that level of product taste, technical speed, and retention thinking into a regulated, high-trust category where quality and safety matter.

This is a high-ownership IC role with founder-level visibility and a direct path to management of a large product organization. You will work directly with engineering, design, clinical, operations, growth, data, compliance, and the founders to turn messy real-world care delivery into simple, powerful product experiences.




✅ RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

 - Own core patient-facing product surfaces across the full consumer journey: discovery, onboarding, intake, insurance/payment clarity, scheduling, provider fit, visit prep, visit completion, follow-up, care-plan adherence, refills, renewals, messaging, support, retention, and reactivation.

 - Translate complex clinical, operational, regulatory, and AI workflows into simple consumer experiences that reduce anxiety, increase clarity, and help patients know exactly what to do next.

 - Build durable product systems, not one-off features: patient timeline, care status, tasking, reminders, notifications, escalation paths, asynchronous messaging, support deflection, eligibility logic, provider availability, and follow-up workflows.

 - Partner with engineering to scope and ship technically sound products across web, mobile-responsive experiences, backend workflows, APIs, third-party integrations, event pipelines, data models, and AI-assisted workflows.

 - Define and own product metrics for your surface area, including activation, intake completion, scheduling conversion, first-visit completion, time to care, repeat-visit rate, renewal completion, retention, NPS/CSAT, patient confusion, support burden, no-shows, and ops cost per visit.

 - Use PostHog, SQL, analytics tools, customer support data, operational dashboards, and qualitative research to identify patient friction, prioritize product bets, and measure whether shipped work moved the right metrics.

 - Design and run structured experiments where appropriate, while knowing when a healthcare product needs principled product judgment, clinical input, and quality thresholds instead of pure A/B testing.

 - Own product specs, user stories, acceptance criteria, rollout plans, QA checklists, experiment plans, metric definitions, launch notes, and post-launch readouts with enough clarity that engineering, clinical, ops, and growth can all execute cleanly.

 - Prototype quickly using Figma, v0, Lovable, Replit, Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, lightweight scripts, no-code tools, or whatever helps you make product ideas concrete before engineering invests real cycles.

 - Ship production PRs regularly. This is a product role—not a software-engineering role—but you are expected to work directly in the codebase and open production-quality PRs for well-scoped changes such as instrumentation, internal tools, workflow logic, UI and copy improvements, prototypes, and small fixes. You should be comfortable testing, reviewing, and safely rolling out your work in close partnership with engineering.

 - Partner with clinical and operations teams to deeply understand real patient and provider workflows, including edge cases: missed appointments, medication refill timing, insurance confusion, state/provider availability, pharmacies, clinical escalations, patient safety concerns, handoffs, and support loops.

 - Partner with compliance, legal, privacy, and clinical leadership to design AI-enabled product experiences with appropriate safeguards, human review, auditability, expectation-setting, and patient trust.

 - Improve Legion’s AI product layer: patient-facing AI interactions, AI-assisted intake, personalization, care navigation, workflow automation, internal copilots, clinical/ops review queues, and evaluation loops that make automation safer and more useful over time.

 - Create product feedback loops from patient conversations, support tickets, provider feedback, drop-off data, session recordings, funnel analytics, and clinical/ops metrics so the roadmap is grounded in real behavior, not vibes.

 - Work with growth and brand to ensure acquisition promises match the actual product experience, so the patients we bring in understand what Legion does, feel properly oriented, and are more likely to stay in care.

 - Raise the product craft bar across Legion: clearer flows, better defaults, fewer dead ends, tighter copy, sharper state handling, cleaner mobile experiences, stronger instrumentation, faster iteration, and more rigorous launch quality.




🏆 YOU’LL BE SUCCESSFUL IF YOU…

 - Make Legion’s patient experience feel consumer-grade: fast, clear, calm, trustworthy, and easy to return to.

 - Improve the core retention loop of care: more patients complete intake, make it to their first visit, understand the next step, follow through on care plans, complete renewals when eligible, and come back when they need help.

 - Turn messy clinical and operational workflows into product systems that scale without making patients feel like they are navigating a maze.

 - Ship AI-enabled experiences that feel useful and safe, with clear boundaries around what AI does, what doctors do, and when humans review or intervene.

 - Build a measurement system that makes the patient journey legible: every meaningful step has an owner, a metric, and a path to improvement.

 - Reduce patient confusion and support burden by improving the product itself, not just by adding more manual operations.

 - Help Legion move faster without becoming sloppy: strong specs, smart scoping, crisp decisions, high-quality launches, and honest post-launch learning.

 - Earn trust from engineering because you understand technical constraints and tradeoffs, and from clinical/ops teams because you understand the reality of care delivery.

 - Create product experiences that are emotionally intelligent without being soft, technically sophisticated without being confusing, and ambitious without being reckless.

 - Help build the product foundation for a company that can deliver world-class medical care at dramatically lower cost.




🧰 IDEAL BACKGROUND AND SKILLS

 - 5+ years of product management, product engineering, technical founder, or equivalent experience, with meaningful ownership of consumer-facing web or mobile products.

 - Strong consumer product instincts. You have shipped products that people actually use, understand, trust, and return to, not just internal tools or enterprise workflows.

 - Technical fluency across software product development. You can reason through APIs, data models, event instrumentation, backend workflows, frontend states, AI workflows, latency, failure modes, privacy constraints, and engineering tradeoffs.

 - Hands-on technical curiosity. You can navigate API docs, logs, event payloads, session recordings, agent traces, and enough of a codebase to understand what is really happening without pulling engineers into every first-pass investigation.

 - Experience partnering deeply with engineering and design from problem definition through launch: discovery, PRDs/specs, UX flows, technical scoping, sprint planning, QA, rollout, metric tracking, and iteration.

 - Strong analytical ability. You are comfortable with SQL or equivalent data exploration, product analytics tools such as PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Looker, Hex, or Mode, and you can define useful metrics without waiting for someone else to hand you a dashboard.

 - Track record improving engagement, retention, activation, conversion, habit formation, lifecycle, or core experience metrics in a consumer product.

 - High product taste and UX judgment. You care about copy, information architecture, interaction design, empty states, error states, mobile responsiveness, notification timing, trust cues, and the emotional texture of the user experience.

 - AI-native working style. You already use tools like Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, Lovable, v0, ChatGPT, Claude, Figma AI, or similar tools to prototype, analyze, write, synthesize, debug, and move faster.

 - Comfort working on AI-enabled products where the PM must think about prompt behavior, user expectations, evaluation, quality thresholds, fallback paths, human review, auditability, and safety.

 - Healthcare experience is a strong plus but not required. Experience in another trust-sensitive consumer category such as fintech, insurance, family/kids, identity, privacy, marketplaces, wellness, or regulated consumer products is also valuable.

 - Startup operating mode: high agency, low ego, high urgency, strong writing, strong judgment, strong follow-through. You can create clarity without waiting for a perfect org chart.

 - Ability to work cross-functionally with clinical, operations, support, compliance, legal, growth, data, design, engineering, and founders without losing the thread of the user problem.

 - Excellent writing. You can write crisp strategy docs, product specs, launch plans, decision memos, patient-facing copy, and post-launch analyses.

 - Bias toward building. You are happiest when you are close to the product, close to users, close to the data, and shipping.

 - Bonus: experience at or near companies like Anthropic, OpenAI, Character.AI http://Character.AI, Replit, Cursor, Perplexity, Notion, Duolingo, Oura, WHOOP, Chime, Monarch Money, Rocket Money, Acorns, Function Health, Nourish, General Medicine, Circle Medical, Tava Health, Headway, Rula, Midi Health, Evvy, Ro, Hims & Hers, Thirty Madison, Levels, Superpower, or another breakout consumer product with high craft, high trust, and fast iteration.




💰 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Salary: $190,000 – $330,000

 - Early-Stage Equity: Meaningful ownership in a category-defining company.

 - Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

 - Additional Perks: In-person retreats, meal stipends, AI/product tooling budget, learning stipend, home office support

 - Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

 - Work Hours: Flexible

 - Work Setup: In-person in San Francisco

 - Impact: Build the product layer for a company trying to change health care forever.

 - Autonomy and Learning: Own major patient-facing product surfaces end-to-end, from product strategy through technical scoping, launch, measurement, and iteration.

 - Growth Opportunities: As we scale, this role can grow into Chief Product Officer.




📝 HOW TO APPLY AND HIRING PROCESS

 - Apply here: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/legionhealth/0ffded39-1242-4a35-9bc3-0e5b0ce22276

 - Overview of our hiring process:
   
   1. Resume + Application Screen
   
   2. Founder / Product Interview
   
   3. Technical Product Deep Dive
   
   4. Cross-Functional Interviews with Engineering, Design, Clinical/Ops, Growth, and Founders
   
   5. Professional Reference Checks

 - Estimated time-to-hire: 2 weeks

 - Start date: ASAP

 - Hiring manager: Arthur MacWaters




🤝 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Product Designer — Growth + Core Product (backed by Y Combinator, $5M+ ARR, $23M+ raised)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🧠 ABOUT LEGION HEALTH

At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision? A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.

 

📍 ROLE LOGISTICS

  • Job Type: Full-Time

  • Role Type: Product Design / UX & UI / Brand / Growth Creative

  • Ideal Experience Level: 5+ years or equivalent evidence of exceptional shipped work

  • Location: Onsite in San Francisco, CA

 

🚀 THE OPPORTUNITY

Legion is hiring a Full-Stack Product Designer to own the experience from the first ad or landing page through onboarding and ongoing care. You will combine deep product design with strong visual, brand, and web craft, helping patients understand what Legion does, get into care, and feel confident about what comes next.

You will work closely with Growth, Product, Engineering, and the founders. Your work will span patient experiences, clinician and operator tools, the website, landing pages, lifecycle touchpoints, and acquisition creative. A shared, prioritized backlog will make the tradeoffs between core product delivery and growth experiments explicit.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with end-to-end design ownership: understand the problem, explore alternatives, prototype, craft the interface, contribute directly to implementation, and improve the shipped result. Full-stack means breadth across the design process and product/growth surfaces, including regularly shipping well-scoped production PRs in close partnership with Engineering.

AI-native design is a core expectation of this role. You will use tools such as v0, Claude Design, Figma AI, Cursor, and comparable tools throughout the design process—not as occasional add-ons, but as everyday tools for divergent exploration, interactive prototyping, implementation, and rapid iteration.

 

✅ RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

  • Translate user needs and complex care workflows into clear journeys, information architecture, interaction flows, prototypes, and polished interfaces.

  • Design patient onboarding and ongoing care experiences alongside clinician and operator workflows, with particular attention to clarity, trust, accessibility, and mobile usability.

  • Define complete interaction states, including loading, empty, error, permission, and recovery experiences; write clear interface copy and remove avoidable dead ends.

  • Build a practical design system with reusable components, patterns, and guidance that helps the team ship consistently and quickly.

  • Ship production PRs regularly. This is a product-design role—not a software-engineering role—but you are expected to work directly in the codebase and open production-quality PRs for well-scoped changes such as instrumentation, internal tools, workflow logic, UI and copy improvements, prototypes, and small fixes. You should be comfortable testing, reviewing, and safely rolling out your work in close partnership with engineering.

  • Bring Legion's brand to life across the website, landing pages, lifecycle communications, and acquisition creative.

  • Develop paid-creative concepts and experiment variants with Growth; use performance feedback to sharpen the message and improve the experience.

  • Use user research, usability testing, product analytics, and experiment results to identify friction and decide what to improve.

  • Connect acquisition promises with the product experience, creating a coherent path from first impression to activation and continued care.

  • Work AI-natively throughout the design process. Use v0, Claude Design, Figma AI, Cursor, and comparable tools to generate and compare directions, build high-fidelity interactive prototypes, test ideas earlier, accelerate implementation, and shorten the loop from concept to shipped product—while applying strong judgment to every final decision.

 

🏆 YOU’LL BE SUCCESSFUL IF YOU…

  • Ship clear, useful, visually excellent experiences that patients and teammates can use with confidence.

  • Improve usability, task completion, onboarding conversion, and adoption of the product surfaces you own.

  • Create faster design-to-engineering cycles with fewer avoidable implementation gaps and a reusable component foundation.

  • Deliver a steady cadence of thoughtful landing-page and creative experiments with explicit hypotheses and useful learning.

  • Earn trust as a partner who prioritizes well, explains tradeoffs clearly, and follows through on the shipped result.

 

🧰 IDEAL BACKGROUND AND SKILLS

  • A portfolio of shipped product work that shows the problem, your personal contribution, alternatives, tradeoffs, interaction detail, and outcomes.

  • Strong product-design depth and strong visual craft across typography, layout, brand, and web. We need evidence of both.

  • Experience taking ambiguous problems from discovery through polished UI and production collaboration with engineers. Comfortable working directly in a codebase, using Git and pull requests, testing well-scoped changes, and incorporating engineering review before a safe rollout.

  • Demonstrated fluency with AI-native design and prototyping workflows is required. You should be able to show how you have used v0, Claude Design, Figma AI, Cursor, or comparable tools to materially improve the speed, breadth, fidelity, or quality of shipped work.

  • Website or landing-page work and the ability to develop effective acquisition creative; curiosity about what makes creative perform.

  • Comfort using qualitative feedback and quantitative evidence without reducing every design decision to a single conversion metric.

  • Clear writing, low ego, high ownership, and the ability to balance speed with quality in an early-stage team.

  • Experience in healthcare or another trust-sensitive consumer product is helpful. Sound judgment and strong shipped work matter most.

 

💰 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Salary: $180,000 – $230,000 annual base salary, based on experience

  • Early-Stage Equity: Meaningful ownership in a category-defining company.

  • Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Additional Perks: In-person retreats, meal stipends, learning stipend, and AI tooling budget

  • Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

  • Work Setup: Full-time, onsite in San Francisco, CA

  • Impact: Own the design quality of a coherent care experience across product and growth.

  • Autonomy and Learning: Own your work end-to-end with close cross-functional and founder collaboration.

  • Growth Opportunities: Broaden your design leadership as Legion scales, while staying close to users and the work.

 

🤝 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations & Strategy Lead (backed by Y Combinator, $5M+ ARR, $23M+ raised)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🧠 About Legion Health

At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to collapse both administrative and clinical labor costs while expanding access to care.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of visits in just two years while holding operations costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Job Type: Full-Time

  • Role Type: Revenue Operations / Commercial Strategy / Provider Partnerships / Sales

  • Ideal Experience Level: 7+ years, or an equivalent record of scope and impact

  • Location: Onsite in San Francisco, CA

  • US Visa Sponsorship: No

🚀 The Opportunity

Legion is hiring a Revenue Operations & Strategy Lead to build and operate the commercial system behind Provider Partnerships and referral growth. You will connect our growth goals to territories, account priorities, capacity, incentives, systems, data, workflows, and the decisions our field team makes every day.

This is the commercial side of revenue operations—not billing or revenue-cycle management. You will report to the Head of Provider Partnerships and begin as a senior individual contributor and player-coach across three connected areas: Planning & Performance; Revenue Systems, Data & Automation; and Provider Partnership Operations. As the business grows, you will help determine when those capabilities should become separate roles and build the function ahead of need.

This is also not a reporting-only job. You should be comfortable moving from an ambiguous commercial question to a recommendation, model, dashboard, workflow, or system that people actually adopt. The measure of success is the productivity, predictability, and quality of decisions you enable—not the number of reports you produce.

You will work closely with Provider Partnerships, Growth, Patient Operations, Finance, Product, Engineering, and People. The right person combines rigorous commercial judgment with hands-on systems ability and stays accountable from diagnosis through implementation.

✅ Responsibilities and Deliverables

  • Own commercial planning and forecasting, connecting referral-growth targets to market opportunity, territory coverage, rep capacity, productivity, ramp time, and hiring needs.

  • Design territory, account-segmentation, tiering, and target-account methodologies that concentrate field time on the highest-value provider and practice opportunities.

  • Build scenario models that help leadership decide when to enter markets, add capacity, change coverage, or invest in new programs.

  • Develop quota and incentive methodology, administer attainment reconciliation, and give Alex and Finance decision-ready recommendations with clear controls and economics.

  • Own CRM governance and the commercial data model across providers, practices, contacts, activities, territories, partnership status, referrals, attribution, and forecasts.

  • Define the KPI framework and build trusted dashboards for territory health, activity, conversion, signed practices, first referrals, recurring referral volume, productivity, and risk.

  • Set and execute the commercial technology, automation, and AI roadmap. Evaluate tools, lead implementation, simplify workflows, establish governance, and measure adoption and business impact.

  • Improve the end-to-end Provider Partnerships process from market and account selection through signed partnership, practice launch, first referral, and recurring account growth.

  • Serve as the operating liaison between Provider Partnerships and Growth or Patient Operations when referral handoffs, patient-conversion issues, provider updates, or recurring workflow problems require cross-functional resolution.

  • Establish the operating cadence for forecasts, pipeline and referral reviews, territory performance, quarterly business reviews, and annual planning.

  • Lead cross-functional changes from problem framing through decision, implementation, adoption, and measurable results, with clear owners and durable handoffs.

  • Define the future Revenue Operations & Strategy organization, operating standards, and hiring plan; recruit and develop the team as scale and complexity justify it.

🏆 You’ll Be Successful If You…

  • Give leadership an accurate, forward-looking view of growth, capacity, productivity, and risk—and bring a recommendation when the numbers change.

  • Make territory, hiring, quota, incentive, and market-expansion decisions repeatable and grounded in shared assumptions.

  • Increase Provider Partnerships Manager productivity by focusing field time on the right practices, reducing administrative friction, and improving ramp.

  • Create a CRM, dashboard, and operating cadence that field teams trust because it is useful, current, and simple enough to maintain.

  • Achieve high referral-attribution coverage, strong data integrity, fast exception resolution, and reliable provider-update service levels.

  • Turn decisions into adopted workflows across Provider Partnerships, Growth, Operations, Finance, Product, and Engineering without dropped handoffs.

  • Build systems and capabilities ahead of the moment they would otherwise constrain growth.

  • Surface important risks early, explain the underlying drivers clearly, and stay accountable until the issue is resolved.

🧰 Ideal Background and Skills

  • 7+ years of experience, or an equivalent record of impact, across revenue operations, commercial operations, strategy and operations, business operations, consulting, finance, or another highly analytical operating role.

  • A track record of owning complex, ambiguous initiatives from problem framing through implementation, adoption, and measurable business results.

  • Exceptional analytical and modeling ability across forecasting, capacity planning, territory design, resource allocation, scenario analysis, or performance management.

  • Working fluency with HubSpot, Salesforce, or comparable commercial systems, plus comfort with spreadsheets, BI tools, SQL or SQL-adjacent analysis, and data-quality investigation.

  • Experience building practical operating processes and governance without creating unnecessary bureaucracy for the people doing the work.

  • Strong executive communication and judgment: you can turn complex analysis into a clear recommendation, decision, owner, and next step.

  • Experience driving change through influence and establishing accountability across functions.

jobs.title: Growth Content Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🧠 About Legion Health

At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care. Legion is an insurance-covered virtual psychiatry medical group building AI-enabled tools to make care more accessible and efficient. Our clinicians deliver care, while AI and software handle much of the administrative work so clinicians and patient-support teams can focus on the moments where human judgment and empathy matter most. We combine rich data, production AI, and end-to-end care operations as we work toward a better experience for patients and clinicians. Legion is backed by Y Combinator and leading venture capital firms.

🚀 The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Growth Content Lead to grow Legion across three connected areas: paid acquisition, lifecycle marketing, and site content. You’ll use audience and performance insights to decide where to focus, then develop and improve campaigns, lifecycle communications, and website or landing-page experiences. This is a hands-on generalist role: you’ll set priorities, write briefs, run experiments, and create or adapt content and simple assets, partnering with Design, Product, and Engineering as needed.

Your work will connect the patient journey from first impression through booking and follow-up. You’ll evaluate performance across paid channels, lifecycle engagement, site conversion, bookings, and completed appointments, using insights from each area to guide what the team improves next.

✅ Responsibilities and Deliverables

• Paid acquisition and creative: Own the creative thinking behind paid campaigns, from audience and performance insight through briefs, creative review, and iteration. Assess hooks, messages, formats, visuals, and placement fit, and partner with designers, agencies, and creators to bring strong work to market.

• Paid testing and performance: Maintain a dependable creative testing cadence, with new work entering market at least biweekly. Organize variants, capture what each test teaches us, and manage campaigns and spend against agreed goals, connecting results to bookings and completed appointments.

• Site content and conversion: Own the clarity and quality of growth content across key website and landing pages. Shape page narratives around what prospective patients need to understand, answer common questions, and make next steps easy to follow.

• Site optimization: Use audience, search, and performance insights to prioritize page improvements and assess progress toward booking. Partner with SEO, Product, and Engineering on page experience, implementation, and content QA.

• Lifecycle content: Plan, write, and improve communications for key moments in the patient journey, from initial interest and booking through follow-up. Keep messages timely, relevant, and consistent with Legion’s voice.

• Lifecycle journeys and learning: Work with Growth and relevant partners on audiences, triggers, and cadence. Review engagement and downstream booking performance, then use what you learn to improve each journey. Familiarity with a lifecycle platform such as Resend is helpful.

• Briefing across all three pillars: Turn audience research, performance data, and brand strategy into clear briefs for paid, site, and lifecycle content. Define the audience, objective, insight, message, format, call to action, and how each piece will be evaluated.

• Partner across the team: Work closely with Growth, Design, SEO, Engineering, and lifecycle partners to move content from idea to launch. Bring in technical support when measurement, site changes, or integrations need it.

🏆 You’ll Be Successful If…

• Paid acquisition: New creative enters testing at least biweekly, with each round tied to a clear audience insight and question.

• Paid acquisition: Test results show what is working, what the team should change next, and how creative contributes to bookings and completed appointments against agreed goals.

• Site content: Key website and landing pages answer prospective patients’ questions, explain what to expect, and make next steps clear.

• Site content: Page updates are guided by audience, search, and performance insights, with progress toward booking measured against agreed goals.

• Lifecycle marketing: Communications cover agreed moments in the patient journey with timely, relevant messages that feel helpful and consistent with Legion’s voice.

• Lifecycle marketing: Engagement and downstream booking and appointment-completion performance are tracked against agreed goals and used to improve lifecycle journeys.

• Across the journey: Learnings move between paid, site, and lifecycle so messages feel connected and each pillar benefits from what the others are learning.

🧰 Ideal Background and Skills

• 5+ years in growth or content marketing, including hands-on experience with paid acquisition and campaign performance.

• Strong creative judgment: you can look at an ad and assess its hook, message, format, visual execution, and fit for the audience and placement.

• Experience turning performance and audience insights into useful creative briefs, then partnering with designers, agencies, or creators to make the work.

• A track record of testing paid creative and using what you learn to shape the next brief and iteration.

• Experience writing or shaping website and landing-page content, with an eye for clarity, useful next steps, and conversion.

• Experience planning or improving lifecycle communications, including audience journeys, triggered messages, or lifecycle content measurement. Familiarity with a platform such as Resend is helpful.

• Clear writing and editing skills, with an instinct for content that is both compelling and easy to understand across formats.

• Comfort reading performance across paid, site, and lifecycle, and connecting content work to bookings and completed appointments.

• Comfortable collaborating with analysts or engineers when measurement, tracking, or site implementation needs technical support.

• Strong organization, follow-through, and warm, direct communication across Growth, Design, SEO, Engineering, and lifecycle partners.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

• Salary: $145,000–$175,000 annual base salary, based on experience

• Early-Stage Equity: Meaningful ownership in a category-defining company.

• Health Insurance: Medical, dental, and vision benefits

• Additional Perks: In-person retreats, meal stipends, learning stipend, and AI tooling budget

• Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

• Work Setup: Full-time, onsite in San Francisco, CA

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Growth Designer — Paid Creative, Brand & Web UX (Remote Part-Time; backed by Y Combinator, $5M+ ARR, $23M+ raised)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🧠 ABOUT LEGION HEALTH

At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision? A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.

📍 ROLE LOGISTICS

  • Job Type: Part-time independent contractor

  • Role Type: Growth Design / Paid Creative / Brand / Web UX

  • Commitment: Approximately 15–25 hours per week, with the ability to scale during launches and major site work

  • Location: Remote, with reliable overlap with Pacific Time business hours

  • Compensation: $50–$125 per hour, based on portfolio, experience, and scope

🚀 THE OPPORTUNITY

Legion is hiring a part-time Growth Designer to make the path from first impression to patient conversion feel like one coherent experience. You will combine paid-creative strategy, strong visual and brand craft, and thoughtful web UX.

You will partner closely with Consumer Growth, paid media, SEO and web implementation, and Legion’s founders. You will turn growth priorities into compelling creative concepts, high-performing landing pages, and clear website flows that build trust and help patients take the next step.

This is a hands-on role for an independent designer who can move from a rough brief or performance insight to polished, testable work. You will own the design quality of the surfaces you touch and create reusable systems that help the broader team move faster.

AI-native design is a core expectation. You will use Figma AI, Framer AI, image and video generation tools, and comparable tools to explore more directions, prototype faster, and raise the quality and pace of the work while applying strong judgment to every final decision.

✅ RESPONSIBILITIES AND DELIVERABLES

  • Develop paid-creative strategies, concepts, hooks, and visual directions for Meta, TikTok, and other growth channels.

  • Design high-quality ad variants, creator briefs, landing pages, and website experiences that connect the acquisition promise to the next step in the patient journey.

  • Improve Legion’s visual brand across growth surfaces, including typography, layout, imagery, color, hierarchy, and trust signals.

  • Map and simplify key website journeys so patients can quickly understand Legion, decide whether it is right for them, and convert with confidence.

  • Turn campaign performance, user feedback, and growth priorities into clear design hypotheses and a steady cadence of experiments.

  • Build reusable templates, components, and lightweight brand guidance that make future creative and landing-page work faster and more consistent.

  • Deliver implementation-ready work in Figma and, when useful, Framer or Webflow; collaborate closely with web and engineering partners through launch and iteration.

  • Use AI tools throughout concepting, prototyping, production, and iteration to increase speed and creative range.

🏆 YOU’LL BE SUCCESSFUL IF YOU…

  • Create a coherent, visually excellent journey from ad to landing page to website.

  • Ship a steady cadence of strong creative and web experiments with explicit hypotheses and useful learning.

  • Improve the clarity, trust, and conversion performance of the growth surfaces you own.

  • Give the team reusable design systems and templates that increase speed without lowering quality.

  • Operate independently, communicate clearly, and reliably turn ambiguous priorities into finished work.

🧰 IDEAL BACKGROUND AND SKILLS

  • A strong portfolio that includes beautiful homepages or landing pages, intuitive web flows, and brand or growth creative. Show your personal contribution and the result.

  • Exceptional visual craft across typography, layout, hierarchy, imagery, and brand systems, paired with sound UX judgment.

  • Experience turning an audience insight or growth brief into multiple creative concepts and testable variants.

  • Fluency in Figma. Experience with Framer, Webflow, motion, creator or UGC briefs, or direct-response creative is helpful.

  • Comfort using qualitative feedback and quantitative performance data to improve work without reducing every design decision to a single metric.

  • Demonstrated use of AI-native creative and design tools to materially improve the speed, range, or quality of real work.

  • Clear writing, low ego, high ownership, and strong asynchronous collaboration.

  • Experience in health care or another trust-sensitive consumer category is helpful. Strong judgment and exceptional work matter most.

💰 COMPENSATION & ENGAGEMENT

  • Hourly Rate: $50–$125 per hour, based on portfolio quality, relevant experience, speed, and scope.

  • Time Commitment: Approximately 15–25 hours per week, with the ability to scale during launches and major site work.

  • Work Setup: Remote independent-contractor engagement with reliable overlap with Pacific Time business hours.

  • Engagement: Ongoing part-time contract. This engagement does not include equity, commission, bonuses, or employee benefits.

🤝 EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.
